subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR path, close or ignore it, or clear this issue for a fresh current-main ClawSweeper fix?
rationale: A concrete fix is small, but GitHub still shows an open fork PR with closing syntax and this issue carries no-new-fix-pr/linked-pr-open state; automation should not create competing fix work until a maintainer chooses the landing path.

options.title: Clear fork PR, then fix fresh
options.body: Treat the open fork PR as not landing here, then allow a narrow current-main fix with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt the fork work
options.body: Port or rebase the fork PR into the current Debug page/view split, preserving attribution and adding the missing tests/proof.

options.title: Defer the UX fix
options.body: Keep this issue open but leave fix automation paused if maintainers want to batch it with broader Control UI debug work.

recommendation.title: Clear fork PR, then fix fresh
recommendation.body: Treat the open fork PR as not landing here, then allow a narrow current-main fix with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Debug page/view split and localization-sensitive surface are most recently attributed to vincentkoc, making them the best routing owner for the landing-path decision.
